note: Hand-curated, kept current by ingest/models_watch.py which flags models the feeds mention but this file is missing. Benchmark scores, prices and speeds are deliberately NOT copied here: they change weekly and belong to the platforms that measure them, so each row links out to Artificial Analysis and LMArena. A field left null could not be confirmed from an official page — an unverified number is worse than no number. 'data_source' names where the entry came from.
